_comment: Expected signatures for the three benchmark models, checked by
A GGUF's filename does not establish its identity: two exports of the same
model can share a name and approximate size while differing in skip-layer
selection or quantization recipe. Verifying size, tensor mix, skip-layer set
and sha256 against these signatures makes the identity explicit before any
measurement is attributed to a checkpoint.
sha256 is authoritative where given; tensor_mix additionally catches a
re-export that changes content while preserving the size.

baseline-fp16.notes: output.weight is a byte-identical duplicate of token_embd.weight: Qwen3-0.6B sets tie_word_embeddings=true, but convert_hf_to_gguf.py materializes the tensor regardless. This adds 311.2 MB to the baseline's disk and RAM figures.

ptq-2bit.provenance: Generated locally by scripts/quantize_ptq.sh, 2026-08-04. NOT downloaded.
ptq-2bit.notes: Baseline quantized with F16 tied embeddings matching the QAT export, so that no embedding-precision advantage is attributed to QAT training. Both 2-bit variants are 310 tensors / 0.5960 B elements with identical tensor names. Superseded build (347288896 bytes, untied, Q2_K embeddings) measured WikiText-2 275.89 / C4 361.61; those figures do not apply to this file. Current values are recorded in results/.

qat-2bit.provenance: HF AMR5210/qwen3-0.6b-qat-q2k, fineweb-blend/qwen3-0.6b-qat-fineweb-blend-q2_k.gguf, downloaded 2026-08-04. HF blob sha matched local sha256.
qat-2bit.notes: Final FineWeb-blend checkpoint (step 48828), the current best on both eval sets. An earlier 12-skip-layer export (510971712 bytes) is superseded; it carried three additional skip-layers (blk.18.ffn_gate, blk.6.ffn_down, blk.8.ffn_gate) and corresponds to no recorded run.

parity._comment: Claim B requires the two 2-bit variants to differ only in training, so these structural properties are checked as a pair.
parity.known_divergence: Confined to the transformer body and bidirectional: PTQ holds 83 tensors at higher precision (Q3_K vs Q2_K), QAT holds 9 (F16 skip-layers). Body excluding the shared 311.2 MB embedding: PTQ 168.6 MB vs QAT 184.0 MB (+9.1%). Disk 479.8 vs 495.2 MB (+3.2%). Closely matched rather than identical by construction.
